description: Waxpol Scratch Remover (For Use on Mild Scratches on All Colours) 150 gmWaxpol Scratch Remover is for use on any color of paint. Unlike other products that hide and cover up scratches, this actually removes light scratches and swirl marks. It enhances paint color and clarity, to make the surface look like new. For removal of fine scratches, swirls, haze, blemishes, surface oxidation, bird droppings, tree sap, minor paint marks and water spotting. Applicable on all Automotive Paint finishes including Clear Coat, Metallic and Two Part Paint Systems of Cars, Motorcycles, Boats, etc. Can also be used on Fiberglass, Stainless Steel, Chrome, Aluminum, Brass, etc. Packing: 150g tube. Direction to use: 1.Squeeze a pea sized amount of the scratch remover on the applicator 2.Work only on the effected area 3.Spread it uniformly by using a firm overlapping to and fro motion in the direction of the scratch, until dry 4.Use a clean dry cloth for a final wipe, to remove residue and excess product 5.Repeat if some scratches are still visible 6.Polish the surrounding area using Waxpol’s Silky Touch to restore luster and shineWaxpol Showroom Finish Liquid Car Polish (150 ml)An exclusive proprietary blend of Premium Waxes and Superior Cleansing Agents to give a Showroom Finish. Clean the Paint Defects and Polish simultaneously! Gently removes Imperfections, Dull Film, Oxidation, Dirt, Swirls, Stains & Minor Scratches and restore with a glossy finish along with nourishing the paint. A transparent thin film protects the paint from UV Ray, Acid Rain, Bugs, Dirt, Oxidation etc. and the Hydrophobic layer provides water beading. Water that falls on the surface becomes a bead and rolls off the easily which saves the paint from water spots, Acid Rain Damage etc. Easy to use Liquid Polish Wax with Applicator for use on All Colours & Clear Coat Safe.
